dogecoin.text: Bitwise just listed 4 new crypto ETPs (Bitcoin & Ethereum) on the London Stock Exchange 🎉 — but only for accredited investors. Meanwhile, they’re working on ETFs for Dogecoin and Aptos in the US. Crypto’s going mainstream one ETP at a time! 🚀

🚀 Dogecoin might soon hit Wall Street! Nasdaq just filed to list a 21Shares DOGE ETF, aiming to bring the meme coin to mainstream investors. With over 70 crypto ETFs awaiting SEC review, altcoins could be gearing up for their biggest moment yet! 🐶📈
DOGE is on the move 🚀 — up 18% this week, and analysts say if it reclaims a key price level, we could see a 300% rally before the end of 2025. Buckle up, Dogecoin fans! 🐶💸
